claim_text: Our focus remains on ensuring everyone goes home safe and well after every shift.
context_text: At Fortescue, Family and Safety are key Values. Our focus remains on ensuring everyone goes home safe and well after every shift.；This consistent focus on safety has supported a rolling 12-month TRIFR of 1.3 at 30 June 2025.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 仅提供TRIFR 1.3这一单一安全频率指标，能说明一定安全表现，但不足以充分证明“everyone goes home safe and well after every shift”这一绝对化结果表述，存在夸大漂绿嫌疑。
notes: 证据仅为单一滞后指标，缺少更完整的零伤害或健康结果数据。
